name: GW Elementor Addons
author: Greatives

sections.description:
Discover GW Elementor Addons, the most advanced plugin for Elementor users, offering 40+ free widgets and 120+ pixel-perfect templates to elevate your web design projects. Built with Flexbox containers and Grid containers, the newest and most efficient structural options by Elementor, this plugin ensures top-notch design flexibility and responsiveness.

Key Features

  • 40+ Premium Free Widgets: Create highly functional websites with widgets like Advanced Buttons, Post List Titles, Content Switchers, and Scrolling Images included for free.
  • 120+ Free Pre-made Templates: Save time with a wide array of professionally designed, fully customizable templates for pages, sections, pricing tables, landing pages, and more.
  • Modern Structure:: Developed with Elementor’s cutting-edge Flexbox and Grid container systems, ensuring your designs are lightweight, responsive, and future-proof.
  • Performance Optimized: Clean code and modular loading ensure your website is fast without unnecessary overhead.
  • Intuitive Design: No coding knowledge required! All widgets and templates are seamlessly integrated with Elementor’s drag-and-drop builder.

Whether you’re a web designer, developer, or business owner, GW Elementor Addons provides all the tools you need to create stunning, responsive websites with ease.

Why Choose GW Elementor Addons?

  • 100% Free Forever: No subscriptions. No hidden costs.
  • Blazing Fast: Lightweight code for optimized performance.
  • Regular Updates: Stay ahead with new features, widgets, and templates.
  • Community-Driven: Share ideas, request features, and help shape the future of GW Addons.

Widget Pages

Explore all the widgets that come with GW Elementor Addons:

Classic Widgets:

  • Accordion – Unveil information with a touch of elegance using the GW Accordion element.
  • Advanced Button – Not just another button. Empower your users to take action with the GW Button widget.
  • Button – Empower your users to take action with the GW Button widget.
  • Pricing List – Clearly outline your offerings in a format that captivates and convinces.
  • Pricing Table – Unlock the perfect plan with the GW Pricing Table element.
  • Tab – Transform navigation into an intuitive journey.
  • Tour – An engaging way to guide your audience through structured information.
  • Contact Form 7 – From inquiries to collaborations, bridge the gap effortlessly.

Typo & More:

  • Advanced Title – Where words become a visual masterpiece.
  • Callout – Command attention and inspire action effortlessly.
  • Data Table – From numbers to insights, organize and present information with clarity and style.
  • Highlighted Text – Underline your words and paint with color to emphasize key points, turning your content into a visual masterpiece.
  • List – Elevate content structure effortlessly.
  • Marquee Text – Create auto-scrolling text sections effortlessly, adding a captivating touch to your web pages.
  • Slogan – Seamlessly blend titles, descriptions, and buttons into a harmonious symphony of options.
  • Typed Text – Welcome to the dynamic and engaging typography world.

Infographics:

  • Counter – From achievements to milestones, watch the digits rise in a visually captivating display.
  • Fancy Box – Unleash creativity as images and content come to life in a sleek and captivating presentation.
  • Icon Box – Transform your content with the GW Icon Box element – where vibrant icons meet compelling text.
  • Progress Bars – From milestones to achievements, visualize your journey with dynamic progress bars.

Carousels:

  • Content Carousel – A seamless way to feature diverse content and enhance user interaction.
  • Image Carousel – Journey through a dynamic display of images, creating a seamless storytelling experience.
  • Testimonial Carousel – Display client testimonials dynamically in an interactive carousel.
  • Posts Carousel – Whether it’s blog brilliance, portfolio gems, or product perfection, turn your creations into a dynamic carousel.

Extras:

  • Content Switcher – A sleek toggle-style switcher, making it ideal for showcasing comparisons.
  • Menu – Effortlessly integrate menus anywhere on your site, creating a seamless and user-friendly browsing experience.
  • Social Links – Showcase your social media icons in style.
  • Team – A showcase of talent and expertise unites strengths and personalities seamlessly.
  • Testimonial Grid – Let the voices of satisfied clients speak volumes, turning trust into a visual masterpiece. Inspire confidence effortlessly.
  • Page Title – A premium widget designed to effortlessly integrate dynamic page titles into your Elementor-built pages.

Media:

  • Auto Scrolling Images – Whether vertical, horizontal, or dancing left to right, transform your space into a dynamic canvas. Immerse your audience in a visual journey with our Auto-scrolling Images widget.
  • Cascading Images – Immerse your audience in a visual cascade with the GW Cascading Images element.
  • Image Gallery Broken – Embrace creativity as images find their unique spaces, forming a mosaic of visual intrigue.
  • Video Button – Seamlessly integrate YouTube, hosted, or custom videos, transforming your content into an immersive visual experience.
  • Hotspot – A captivating feature that transforms static images into engaging, interactive experiences.
  • Image Box – Where images, titles, text, and buttons harmonize to create a visual masterpiece.
  • Image Gallery – From snapshots to masterpieces, create a visual journey that captivates and inspires.
  • Image Text – Craft stories that resonate, seamlessly blending image and narrative for an immersive experience.
  • Text Inline Image – Seamlessly blends text and images for a harmonious visual experience.

Posts Overview:

  • Posts List Titles – Display post titles with hover effects and featured images.
  • Posts – Whether you prefer a classic Grid layout or a stylish Masonry design, this premium widget offers flexibility to showcase your content dynamically.
  • Posts Broken – Break free from simple grids as your blog posts, portfolio gems, or products find a unique and captivating layout.
  • Posts List – Whether you prefer a classic Grid layout or a stylish Masonry design, this premium widget offers flexibility to showcase your content dynamically.

Sliders:

  • Posts Slider – From blog posts to portfolio gems, effortlessly create a slider that weaves through your creations.

Try it now for free on WordPress.org and elevate your Elementor experience.

Documentation & Support

We’ve got you covered with:

  • Comprehensive Documentation: Explore step-by-step guides, tutorials, and tips to master every widget and template in GW Elementor Addons.Visit our Knowledge Base.
  • Professional Support: Even as a free plugin, we’re here to ensure your questions are answered promptly and effectively.

About Greatives

GW Elementor Addons is proudly brought to you by Greatives, a leading design agency with over 10 years of experience in WordPress design and development, we bring our expertise to this fully free plugin.

External services

This plugin fetches Elementor templates from our GitHub repository when the user chooses to load a template.

What data is sent and when:
– When a user selects a template, the plugin sends a request to GitHub to retrieve the template data (in JSON format) for that template.
– No personal or user data is sent to GitHub. Only the request for the template data is made.

Terms of Service and Privacy Policy:
– This service is hosted on GitHub. Users can review GitHub’s Terms of Service and Privacy Policy here:
– GitHub Terms of Service
– GitHub Privacy Policy

Credits

GW Elementor Addons was created by the Greatives Team. Special thanks to the WordPress and Elementor communities.
sections.installation:
Installation

  1. Download and Install: Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/gw-elementor-addons directory or install directly from WordPress.org.
  2. Activate: Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Use with Elementor: Open Elementor and start using the widgets and templates provided by GW Addons.
sections.faq:
How do I install GW Elementor Addons?

  1. Download and Install: Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/gw-elementor-addons directory or install directly from WordPress.org.
  2. Activate: Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Use with Elementor: Open Elementor and start using the widgets and templates provided by GW Addons.

For detailed tutorials, visit our Knowledge Base.

What is GW Elementor Addons by Greatives?

GW Elementor Addons is an innovative custom plugin that enhances the Elementor page builder experience. This plugin introduces a wide array of powerful, lightweight widgets crafted carefully to ensure a visually appealing design. Each widget is created with modern aesthetics in mind, allowing designers to build stunning, interactive websites effortlessly. With GW Elementor, users can take advantage of enhanced functionalities that streamline the design process, enabling the creation of unique layouts and dynamic content without any coding knowledge. Whether you are a seasoned web designer or just starting, GW Elementor provides the tools to elevate your projects and achieve a professional look.

Is GW Elementor Addons really free?

Yes! The GW Elementor Addons is completely free to use and will remain free forever.
Enjoy 40+ premium widgets and 120+ professionally designed templates at no cost, all tailored to take your Elementor designs to the next level. There are no hidden fees or limitations—just powerful tools to help you build beautiful, responsive websites with ease.

Can I use these elements with any WordPress theme?

Yes, the GW Elementor Addons plugin is designed to be compatible with most WordPress themes. Whether you have a custom or popular theme, our plugin seamlessly integrates with your existing setup.

How do I access the free templates?

Once the plugin is activated, the templates will be accessible directly through the Elementor editor.

Can I request new widgets or features?

Of course! Fill out our Feedback Form to share your ideas or requests for new features.

Do I need Elementor Pro to use GW Elementor Addons?

No, you do not. However, the GW Elementor Addons is designed to work seamlessly with the free version of Elementor and Elementor Pro. While both versions are compatible, it’s important to note that some advanced features offered by the GW Addons are specifically tailored to enhance the functionalities available in Elementor Pro. Users with Elementor Pro may find additional enhancements that complement their design capabilities, allowing for more sophisticated and customized layouts while still benefiting from the basic functionalities in the free version.
